summary: The simulation model requires significant improvements to align with the task specifications and ensure accurate modeling of mask-wearing behavior through social networks. Critical issues include incorrect initialization of agent attributes, lack of government intervention modeling, and incomplete evaluation metrics implementation. Addressing these will enhance predictivity and realism.
